entries.en: Use the reinforcing mortar on the damaged walls.

entries.en: Ho there! If you're not otherwise occupied at the moment, how's about lending me a hand or two? They've got me on repair duty, and what with the sorry shape this place is in, it's definitely not a one-man job.
entries.fr: Bonjour, voyage. Vous avez l'air de vous ennuyer... J'ai du travail pour vous, si ça vous intéresse ! Notre division logistique manque cruellement de bras en ce moment...
entries.ja:
そこの君、暇なら手を貸してくれないか？
折からの人員不足で、後方支援部門に人が回ってこないんだ。
どうか城の設備維持のため、補修作業を手伝ってくれ！

entries.en: It's a simple enough task. Just take this here pail of mortar, find a couple of spots where the walls are looking ragged, and apply a healthy dab. Thanks, friend─what with our ranks thinned as they are, we need all the help we can get!
entries.fr: Certains recoins du château sont fragilisés et auraient bien besoin d'une petite retouche. Prenez ce  et allez colmater ces quelques fissures, vous nous rendrez un fier service !

entries.en: Truth be told, the whole fort needs a good patching up after what we've been through. But with supplies and manpower limited as they are, all we can do is focus on the places that need it most.

entries.en: I saw you hard at work out there, friend! I'll rest easy tonight knowing that some of the ugliest patches of our walls are looking as good as new.
entries.fr: Vous avez déjà fini ? Fantastique ! Merci beaucoup, je ne sais pas ce qu'on aurait fait sans vous !

entries.en: Are you familiar with the history of the Imperative, perchance? It was built nigh on a century ago, by the elves who ruled Lakeland in those days. After the Flood, it's served as one of our bastions of defense against the sin eaters.
entries.fr: Vous le saviez peut-être mais L'Impératif d'Ostall a été construit par les Elfes de la Fédération de Grand-Lac. Il a servi de base pendant la guerre contre les purgateurs qui a eu lieu juste après le déluge de Lumière.
entries.ja:
もともと、このオスタル厳命城は、
エルフの国家、レイクランド連邦が築いた城でな。
「光の氾濫」直後は、罪喰いとの激戦が繰り広げられた場所だ。

entries.en: Yes, this fort's taken its fair share of beatings, but it stands tall to this day, watching over and protecting the Crystarium and its people. And it's our job to keep it standing─material and manpower shortages be damned.
entries.macro: Yes, this fort's taken its fair share of beatings, but it stands tall to this day, watching over and protecting the Crystarium and its people. And it's our job to <italic(1)>keep<italic(0)> it standing─material and manpower shortages be damned.
entries.fr: On a continué d'essayer de le maintenir en bon état depuis, mais malgré le fait que ce soit un des piliers de la ligne magistrale de Cristarium, on n'a pas assez de main d'œuvre...

entries.en: 'Course, we couldn't do it without the generous efforts of volunteers like you. I reckon you have a real talent for repairs─mayhap I could interest you in joining the guard as a full-time wall mender?
entries.fr: N'empêche, quelle chance d'avoir croisé votre chemin aujourd'hui ! Vous... Vous ne voudriez pas rejoindre nos rangs ?
entries.ja:
いやはや、君みたいな「仲間」がいてくれて助かった。
これからも工兵の一員として、やっていかないかい？

entries.en: Ahahaha! I jest, of course. I've already taken enough of your time today. Thank you, friend, and be careful out there.
